system.description: When you take the Assist action on an ally's spell, that spell gains: +2 to the caster's Magic Check (SL1); the spell deals or heals +(SL × 5) (SL2); the spell's MP cost is reduced by (SL × 5) (SL3). All unlocked benefits apply at the appropriate SL.
